property_summary: For any input _val when SetMinSum is called on a fresh-contract instance before Initialized(), the reference sets MinSum to exactly _val (overwriting the initial value), whereas the mutant instead increments MinSum by _val so MinSum != _val for some inputs (e.g., when initial MinSum != 0) — this test fuzzes _val and checks that after SetMinSum the getter equals the provided _val.
change_summary: Change assignment to add _val to MinSum instead of replacing it, so MinSum increases by _val when called.
